evals.prompt: Wire SolvaPay hosted checkout into my Lovable app (Vite + shadcn + Supabase). Use the preview/dev backend and paste-in flow.
evals.expected_output: Agent loads lovable-checkout, reads references/GUIDE.md, installs @preview packages, creates Supabase edge functions, keeps secret in edge secrets only.
assertions: SOLVAPAY_SECRET_KEY is placed in Supabase edge secrets — not VITE_* or committed .env in repo
Browser calls go through Supabase edge functions, not direct api-dev fetch with secret

evals.prompt: Add SolvaPay checkout to my Next.js production website on Vercel — not a Lovable project.
evals.expected_output: Agent routes to solvapay/website-checkout, not lovable-checkout (preview-only skill).
assertions: Handoff to solvapay/website-checkout or explicit note that lovable-checkout is preview/dev only
Does not pin @preview packages for production Next.js path

evals.prompt: Lovable app — can I put SOLVAPAY_SECRET_KEY in .env as VITE_SOLVAPAY_SECRET so the vite client can create checkout sessions?
evals.expected_output: Agent refuses client-side secret, follows GUIDE.md edge-secret pattern and edge-proxied API calls.
assertions: Agent explicitly rejects exposing SOLVAPAY_SECRET_KEY via VITE_* or client bundle
Agent directs secret to Supabase edge secrets (or equivalent server-only storage)
